Nollywood actress Adesua Etomi-Wellington has announced that she has tested negative for cancer after months of medical procedures, hospital visits and uncertainty over her health. The actress shared the news on Friday in an Instagram video, saying, “The doctor just called me back with the result from the lab, no cancer…God is good.” In the video, Etomi-Wellington was seen undergoing medical tests, while other pictures showed bruises on her body and redness beneath one of her eyes. She also shared a video of friends and well-wishers celebrating the test result and expressing gratitude to God. Reflecting on the difficult year, she wrote, “2026 really tried it. I know I’ve been quieter than usual this year (and that’s saying something), but behind the silence were some of the most difficult months of my life.” Make PUNCH part of your everyday experience. Add us to your Preferred Sources She further disclosed that her health challenges involved repeated medical procedures, scans, injections and hospital visits, adding that she had received care from medical teams in Nigeria and the United States. “This year threw everything at me, but by the grace of God, I am NOT EASILY BROKEN,” she wrote. Etomi-Wellington also thanked her husband, singer Bankole Wellington, popularly known as Banky W, their children, friends and family members who supported her through the difficult period. Actress Lolo1 bags master’s degree, daughter graduates with first class Words fail me, Yul Edochie mourns father Mr Latin bows out as TAMPAN president after eight years “To my friends and family who prayed for me, stood in the gap and held me through some of my darkest days, I will never take your love for granted,” she added. The actress’s latest health revelation comes after she and her husband released a gospel song, On My Way, on Wednesday, November 25, to mark their ninth wedding anniversary. The song, credited to Susu, Etomi-Wellington’s musical name, and Banky W, is the lead single from their forthcoming joint album, Not Easily Broken, expected in 2027. The actress said the song had become a reflection of their experience, describing it as “the soundtrack to our testimony and thanksgiving.” The couple have previously spoken publicly about their health challenges. In May 2024, PUNCH reported that Banky W underwent his fourth surgery for cancer , with the singer expressing gratitude for his recovery. He had earlier disclosed that he had undergone surgeries to remove cancerous tumours. Etomi-Wellington also revealed in March 2025 that she battled hyperemesis gravidarum, a severe form of pregnancy sickness, during her second pregnancy. The condition left her ill for months, requiring hospitalisation before she underwent an emergency Caesarean section. Christabel Ndoeche
